owners.analytics: dedicated Our Little World PostHog project

supabase.scheduler: route and marketing dispatch every five minutes; operational alert evaluation every ten minutes

incident_and_resolution.incident: During controlled production testing, two website test aliases entered the existing parent audience and received the first parent-onboarding message.
incident_and_resolution.impact: Controlled test identities only; no public visitor send was observed.
incident_and_resolution.cause: The existing parent audience had provider-native signup automation, so list subscription itself was an unintended enrollment trigger.
incident_and_resolution.resolution: A new website-only audience with zero campaigns was created; active website contacts were migrated, controlled contacts were unsubscribed from the parent audience, and the sync worker was changed so provider subscription never marks welcome enrollment.
incident_and_resolution.post_resolution_evidence: A third controlled production signup synchronized only to the website audience, had zero welcome jobs, was absent from the parent audience, and received no parent-onboarding message during the observation window.
incident_and_resolution.observation_window: several minutes after provider sync; exact duration was not instrumented

hosted_confirmation_incident.incident: The Our Little World double-opt-in email showed a Get Mentors contact address, and the confirmation page Continue to website button opened getmentors.ai.
hosted_confirmation_incident.cause: The new audience's Required email footer content retained Get Mentors values for contact email and Website URL. These fields are separate from the API-visible campaign sender defaults.
hosted_confirmation_incident.resolution: Updated only the Our Little World Website Launch audience footer contact to support@ourlittleworld.me and Website URL to https://ourlittleworld.me/.
verification: Mailchimp confirmed the footer settings save.
A readback of the audience footer editor returned the OLW support address and OLW website URL.
The Form Builder confirmation-page preview resolved Continue to website to https://ourlittleworld.me/.
The audience API now returns an ourlittleworld.us14.list-manage.com hosted signup URL.
The public hosted signup page returned 200 with Our Little World branding and zero Get Mentors references.

post_fix_regression.required_next_check: Complete the disposable-address production double-opt-in round trip documented in apps/web/README.md before changing this incident status to fully_resolved.

controlled_data.active_contact_disposition: Retained temporarily as acceptance fixtures in the isolated zero-campaign audience, tagged controlled-test-2026-07-13; unsubscribe or remove before any campaign is created and no later than the evidence-retention review.

rollback.website: Promote the previous healthy Vercel production deployment and keep commerce coming_soon.
rollback.provider_writes: Set OUR_LITTLE_WORLD_MAILCHIMP_SYNC_ENABLED=false. Keep signed webhooks enabled so suppressions continue to flow into the canonical ledger.
rollback.edge_functions: Redeploy the prior function source version.
rollback.database: Migrations are additive. Do not delete consent history or destructively roll back tables during an incident.
rollback.audiences: Do not merge the website audience into the parent audience and do not delete either audience as an incident response.
